publisher.zh: 中国领事服务网（外交部）
publisher.en: China Consular Service (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

summary.zh: 持普通护照来华经商、旅游观光、探亲访友、交流访问、过境，停留不超过 30 天，可免办签证入境。
summary.en: Ordinary passport holders may enter visa-free for business, tourism, visiting family or friends, exchanges or transit, staying up to 30 days.

not_covered.zh: 不符合免签条件的，仍需在入境前办妥来华签证。
not_covered.en: If you do not meet these conditions, get a Chinese visa before you travel.

publisher.zh: 中国驻澳大利亚大使馆：关于延长单方面免签政策的通知
publisher.en: Chinese Embassy in Australia: Notice on extending the unilateral visa-free policy

summary.zh: 持普通护照来华经商、旅游观光、探亲访友、过境，停留不超过 30 天，可免办签证入境。
summary.en: Ordinary passport holders may enter visa-free for business, tourism, visiting family or friends or transit, staying up to 30 days.

not_covered.zh: 不符合免签条件的，仍需在入境前办妥来华签证。
not_covered.en: If you do not meet these conditions, get a Chinese visa before you travel.

publisher.zh: 中国驻温哥华总领事馆：对加拿大、英国免签政策的通知
publisher.en: Chinese Consulate General in Vancouver: Notice on the visa-free policy for Canada and the UK

publisher.zh: 外交部发言人答记者问
publisher.en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson's remarks

summary.zh: 持本人普通护照和确定日期及行程的联程客票，经中国前往第三国或地区，可从 24 个省份 65 个开放口岸中的任一口岸免签入境，在规定区域停留活动不超过 10 天。
summary.en: With your own ordinary passport and an onward ticket with a confirmed date and itinerary to a third country or region, you may enter visa-free at any of 65 open ports in 24 provinces and stay up to 10 days within the permitted area.

not_covered.zh: 工作、学习、新闻采访等需事先批准的活动，仍应办妥签证。具体口岸和停留区域以官方为准。
not_covered.en: Work, study, journalism and other activities that need prior approval still require a visa. Check the official list for ports and permitted areas.

publisher.zh: 国家移民管理局：过境免签政策（57 国）
publisher.en: National Immigration Administration: Visa-free transit policy (57 countries)

summary.zh: 外国人入境卡可在出发前网上填报，官方服务免费。境外有假冒网站收费，只走官方渠道：国家移民管理局网页、「移民局12367」、微信和支付宝小程序。来不及提前填的，入境口岸有自助设备和纸质入境卡。
summary.en: You can fill in China's arrival card online before you fly. The official service is free. Fake sites charge fees, so use only official channels: the NIA web page, the NIA 12367 app, or the WeChat and Alipay mini-programs. If you cannot do it in advance, ports of entry have self-service devices and paper cards.

publisher.zh: 北京市外办转发国家移民管理局提醒：警惕虚假入境卡填报网站
publisher.en: Beijing Foreign Affairs Office, relaying the NIA warning on fake arrival-card websites
